notes: Frostspine (region_frostspine), v2. Built from templates\ambient_sine_template5.flp (channels renamed locally: celesta = epiano_glass, celesta_b = epiano_glass #2, choir_soft = choir_pad, pad_warm = bass_bowed). epiano_glass on celesta (Analog Harp, insert 2; VCA decay ~5 s, edited in projects\region_frostspine_v2raw.flp), choir_pad on choir_soft (Simple Ohh, insert 4; C4/C#4 an octave down), bass_bowed on pad_warm (12 Low Strings, Osc2 off, +12, insert 8), bell_sparse on celesta_b (in-tune Analog Harp clone, insert 5). Editable project: projects\region_frostspine_v2b.flp.
